responsibility: MinGW-w64-specific option table fragment, currently contributing the `-municode` target switch used to select Unicode startup and define the `UNICODE` macro. It feeds the GCC option machinery with the small set of mingw-w64-only command-line controls needed by the Windows target specs.
same_name_distinction: The option-definition fragment for MinGW-w64, declaring the municode switch for GCC's option machinery; unlike mingw-w64.h it does not define Windows target specs or startup/link behavior, only the recognized option itself.
